findings.evidence: This batch-54 draft supplier says e^(i) × e^(j) is a frame vector e^(i') and writes [A_i,A_j] = i A_(i') without limiting the equality to cyclic distinct pairs. For i=j the cross product is zero; reversing a cyclic pair gives the negative of a frame vector. The classification needs only the three cyclic commutators, which follow by writing [A_i,A_j] = i sum_k epsilon_ijk A_k or listing those cases. The assigned consumer uses clause (c) to define its spin projections.
